question: Can replaceable lightweight visual initialization learn continuous depth, support-surface and obstacle-boundary factors that a deterministic body-swept reducer converts into useful assistive geometry without a direct learned shortcut to final free, blocked or UNKNOWN state?
difference_from_previous: B1-A0 learned depth and applied its frozen task postprocess, while the earlier direct-task arms would have learned terminal task outputs. R2 instead exposes continuously supervised metric-depth, support-surface and obstacle-boundary evidence with uncertainty; only a versioned deterministic interval-geometry reducer may emit clearance, occupancy and final tri-state. R2 uses a new selection cohort and independent threshold provenance.

data_partitions.identity_basis: A later F0 protocol must bind fixture generator, seeds, cases and expected analytic outputs before execution.
Must be frozen after factor-label capability and provenance audit; no B1 Development, Calibration or Confirmation identity may enter.
Brand-new metadata-first roster, frozen before content or target-model outcome, and parent/session/capture-disjoint from all R2 TRAIN and all B1 roles.

input_contract.rgb: display-upright full-valid-FOV image under a separately bound camera-transform receipt

metric_depth.identifiability: Geometric mean of valid depth_shape_positive is normalized to one; metric depth is exp(log_metric_scale_m) times normalized shape.

obstacle_boundary_evidence.meaning: Continuous non-support and depth-discontinuity evidence; it is not a learned blocked/free label.
obstacle_boundary_evidence.target_form: Continuous distance-to-boundary and evidence targets with explicit validity, not only a discrete final occupancy target.

deterministic_geometry_reducer.name: GeometryR2Reducer
steps: reproject valid metric depth through bound K
construct support-surface interval under gravity, plane and residual uncertainty
derive non-support obstacle evidence and conservative boundary intervals
intersect obstacle intervals with versioned left, center and right body-swept volumes
aggregate clearance interval and occupancy evidence at frozen horizons
emit CLEAR_OBSERVED only when every admissible geometry is clear
emit OCCUPIED_OBSERVED only when every admissible geometry is occupied
emit UNKNOWN for overlap, missing support, excessive uncertainty or insufficient evidence

uncertainty_contract.scale: Propagate log-scale and per-pixel depth uncertainty into 3D intervals.
uncertainty_contract.support: Propagate plane normal, camera-height and residual uncertainty; invalid or contradictory support cannot become observed clear.
uncertainty_contract.boundary: Dilate or interval-bound obstacle support by localization uncertainty; ambiguity becomes UNKNOWN rather than an invented obstacle class.

deterministic_invariants.description: Only GeometryR2Reducer may emit clearance, occupancy or final tri-state.
Missing K, transform, scale, support, boundary validity or nonfinite factor payload can emit only UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN never contributes as clear, occupied or negative supervision.
Extending a swept horizon cannot increase minimum clearance or turn an observed occupied nearer horizon into observed clear.
Increasing body width, margin, obstacle evidence or uncertainty cannot turn occupied or UNKNOWN into clear.
Supported crop, rotation and resize transformations with correspondingly transformed K preserve metric geometry within the F0 analytic tolerance.
Clear and occupied intervals are disjoint; overlap or threshold straddling emits UNKNOWN.
Identical factor tensors, receipts, profile and reducer version produce identical serialized GeometryState.
Left, center and right swept-volume ownership is exhaustive and non-overlapping under the bound profile.
Gradients and serialized model outputs contain no direct target or head for final clearance, occupancy, free, blocked or UNKNOWN.

minimal_first_ladder.inputs: Analytic synthetic scenes only: flat and sloped support, empty corridor, isolated obstacle, edge obstacle, scale perturbation, support ambiguity, boundary uncertainty, missing K and each supported orientation.
minimal_first_ladder.actions: Implement factor schema, GeometryR2Reducer and deterministic unit fixtures without a learned model.
gates: analytic clearance interval and tri-state match fixture truth within a pre-execution bound tolerance
all-UNKNOWN, all-blocked and all-clear degenerate controls are rejected by the coverage and class-conditional risk gate harness

minimal_first_ladder.inputs: R2 TRAIN only, split by parent/session into fit and TRAIN_CANARY before outcome; no B1 Development, Calibration or Confirmation.
minimal_first_ladder.actions: Fit at most one minimal factor model plus one frozen depth-only factor anchor from replaceable lightweight initialization; no direct task head.
frontdoor_gates: every admitted task-evaluation frame has complete metric-depth, support and boundary continuous supervision or an explicit non-evaluable validity reason
factor-supervision contract coverage equals 1.0 across admitted frames
serialized factor output field coverage equals 1.0
finite geometry output contract coverage equals 1.0 before any task metric is calculated
each continuous factor improves its predeclared TRAIN-only error over a frozen constant or non-learned control with parent-macro lower confidence bound above zero
minimal_first_ladder.task_pareto_gate: Apply the separately frozen coverage, false-block and false-clear conjunctive Pareto rule only after every frontdoor gate passes.

minimal_first_ladder.inputs: Brand-new, minimum eight-parent metadata-first roster, parent/session/capture-disjoint from R2 TRAIN and all B1 roles.
pre_outcome_freeze: one candidate and one causal depth-only factor anchor
all factor and reducer implementation identities
numeric coverage, false-block and false-clear thresholds with new provenance
Pareto margins and deterministic tie rule
three new predeclared seeds without best-seed selection
roster, aggregation, missing-data and zero-denominator rules
gates: candidate is Pareto non-inferior to the causal anchor on coverage, false-block and false-clear and strictly improves at least one frozen task or continuous-factor axis
at least two of three seeds have the same signed conclusion and median seed passes
all-blocked, all-clear or all-UNKNOWN operating points cannot pass

pareto_gate_contract.threshold_provenance: Derive numeric coverage, false-block, false-clear and non-inferiority margins only from F0 analytic corruption envelopes, explicit task-cost assumptions and F1 TRAIN-only sensitivity. Do not copy or fit to B1 thresholds, B1 Selection outcomes or Clearance-Student screens.
pareto_gate_contract.rationale: A conjunctive, class-conditional Pareto gate prevents a conservative all-blocked or all-UNKNOWN solution from buying a low false-clear score.
pareto_gate_contract.calibration_source: F0 synthetic physical fixtures plus F1 TRAIN-only sensitivity and explicit research body-profile cost assumptions; never B1 outcome.
pareto_gate_contract.sensitivity_plan: Publish the full coverage versus false-block versus false-clear surface and show neighboring predeclared operating points without selecting on F2 outcomes.
pareto_gate_contract.revision_policy: Numeric values may be frozen once in the F1 result-to-F2 protocol transition. After any F2 outcome access, changes require a new version and a different parent/session/capture-disjoint Development roster.

teacher_oracle_lane.truth_rule: Teacher or oracle output is never truth; every teacher emits the same factor schema and passes through the same deterministic reducer.
kill_gates_before_any_distillation: all teachers have factor and geometry-output contract coverage equal to 1.0
truth-bound oracle Pareto gain over the best single teacher has a parent-bootstrap lower confidence bound greater than zero
each teacher is exclusively correct on at least two independent parents
teacher disagreement has truth-error enrichment with lower confidence bound greater than zero
factor-level oracle improvement survives the same coverage, false-block and false-clear conjunctive gate
no teacher uses target-roster truth, final task state or post-truth selection during factor generation

mobile.graph_outputs: raw factor tensors and uncertainty only
mobile.host_outputs: camera transforms, deterministic reducer, body profile, UNKNOWN and final tri-state

calibration_confirmation_policy.allocation_precondition: F2 Development pass plus a separate pre-outcome protocol that freezes candidate, thresholds, roster identities, statistics and missing-data handling.

constraints.description: This protocol may use prior failures only as rationale and never reads or reuses their artifact outcomes for R2 selection.
The learned graph emits only continuous factors and uncertainty; the deterministic reducer alone emits final task geometry.
Continuous factor supervision and complete geometry-output contract coverage pass before any task gate is calculated.
constraints.rationale: Prevents missing factor fields or undefined geometry from being hidden by selective task denominators.
constraints.calibration_source: Schema completeness requirement, not observed performance.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No lower value is explored; frames may instead carry explicit non-evaluable reasons before admission.
constraints.revision_policy: INVARIANT_FOR_R2; a weaker contract requires a new hypothesis version.

constraints.description: Coverage, false-block and false-clear are conjunctive and Pareto-evaluated; no scalar score can trade one away.
constraints.rationale: Rejects all-blocked, all-clear and all-UNKNOWN collapses.
constraints.calibration_source: Pre-outcome task semantics and F0 degenerate controls.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report the full three-axis surface at predeclared neighboring operating points.
constraints.revision_policy: Formula fixed here; numeric values bind in F1 before F2 outcome and then require a new roster to change.

constraints.description: F2 uses a brand-new parent/session/capture-disjoint Development Selection roster and never B1 Selection evidence.
F0 must pass before F1; F1 must pass before F2 roster allocation or outcome access.
constraints.rationale: Stops expensive learning and fresh-data consumption when deterministic mechanics or TRAIN-only learnability already fail.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No unordered execution is allowed in R2.
constraints.revision_policy: A changed order is a new route version.

frozen_now: Pareto gate formula and degenerate controls
unresolved_before_execution: F0 fixture generator and analytic tolerances
F1 TRAIN roster, exact model identity, seeds and budget
numeric task Pareto thresholds and margins
F2 Development roster and evaluator identities

successor_policy.successor_scope: Write a separate F0 protocol, fixture schema and deterministic reducer tests; do not train, read real outcomes or allocate F2 Development.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Before any learned model, analytic synthetic scenes must show that the factor schema and interval reducer satisfy all invariants and reject all-blocked, all-clear and all-UNKNOWN controls.
experiment_design.resource_budget: F0: CPU unit fixtures only. F1: one minimal candidate plus one causal anchor on TRAIN only. F2: one candidate, one anchor, three predeclared seeds, one new Development roster. No teacher, temporal, mobile or device budget is authorized here.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop at the first failed stage. F0 failure closes the reducer implementation version; F1 failure closes the factor learnability candidate before fresh Development allocation; F2 failure closes only the R2 candidate version. No failed stage licenses extra seeds, epochs, direct heads, threshold relaxation or data reuse.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Depth, support surface and obstacle boundaries are continuous visual geometry factors whose uncertainty can be propagated before task thresholds; a deterministic swept-volume layer exposes the exact place where conservatism enters.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Moves final clearance, occupancy and tri-state out of the learned graph and adds explicit continuous support, boundary and uncertainty factors.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates representation failure, scale error, support error, boundary error and reducer threshold behavior instead of observing only final task collapse.
hypotheses.minimal_test: F0 analytic reducer canary followed by F1 parent/session-disjoint TRAIN-only continuous-factor learnability.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Factor completeness and errors, interval geometry invariants, then conjunctive coverage/false-block/false-clear Pareto behavior.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any factor cannot beat its fixed TRAIN-only control, geometry contract coverage is incomplete, or the candidate reaches low false-clear only by failing false-block or known coverage.
hypotheses.resource_budget: One factorized candidate and one causal anchor before F2.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Stop this candidate at the first failed ordered gate.
hypotheses.selection_reason: Directly addresses the identified coupling between uncertain visual evidence and a discrete final task target without adding teacher, temporal or deployment complexity.

failure_learning.observation: No R2 implementation, data outcome, training or evaluation has run.
failure_learning.inference: The protocol defines a materially different, falsifiable candidate but provides no evidence that it works.
alternative_explanations: B1 failure may have come from scale, support estimation, boundary aggregation, threshold sensitivity or their interaction.
R2 factor supervision may itself be unavailable or unlearnable at lightweight capacity.
A deterministic reducer may expose rather than solve the task tradeoff.
constraint_challenges: Prior task thresholds are not inherited; R2 numeric thresholds require new pre-outcome provenance.
next_hypotheses: Only R2-H1 is active for F0; teacher, temporal and mobile lanes remain interfaces without execution authority.
reuse_candidates: B1 failure anatomy may supply named error categories and regression questions only, never R2 selection evidence.

claim_ceiling: Outcome-blind R2 hypothesis, representation, reducer, gate and sequencing contract only. No learnability, utility, teacher, temporal, mobile, Confirmation, deployment, default-App, product or safety authority.
